reviews.text: The last time we went to the vet, he pricked himself several times before finally giving our cat the injection. He then used the same syringe he'd used to inject himself and gave our cat the injection. We were asking questions, and he seemed completely clueless.

My experience with the Wizoo veterinary clinic was very disappointing. I found the follow-up process cumbersome and disorganized.

I had to call several times to get results for tests I had already paid for, and the staff seemed lost regarding treatment follow-up, especially after antibiotics. Furthermore, we experienced a great deal of anxiety due to a diagnosis that turned out to be much less serious than anticipated, not to mention the high cost of prescriptions ($20 per medication) and significant delays in receiving the medication (I waited over 16 days to receive the medication after ordering it at the counter).

Wizoo was a lifesaver when my cat needed it. It's not my regular vet, but when you need a quick appointment, it does the job. Decent service, nothing more. I was surprised by the price when it came time to pay. I think it's important that both the client and the vet get into the habit of discussing the different treatment options and their associated costs before billing. During the consultation, it might seem like just two or three pills. But once the bill arrives… that's a different story!

Staff was nice, but they never called us with results when they said it would be 24-48 hours. We had to call them twice and got told essentially "well the vet is busy so" which is a bit ridiculous. I understand they have a lot of animals to care for, but to give us an exact time and then never call for days after that just feels unacceptable. They also charged over 200$ for an "urgent appointment " Because it was booked a bit after midnight. When we asked why we were charged so much they said it was because of having to coordinate and make room for the appointment last minute with the receptionist over the phone. None of that is true in this case; i booked the appointment online because it was ALREADY available. So ultimately it was because of a technicality and that just feels like a money grab.

Staff is very nice and work very well. However the Vet that is a man, is rude and will talk over you. He does not take the time to listen to you or take notes. It took 3 weeks for my urine report to come in, and he called me at 9pm.  The recommendations he gave me were food products that I had already switched to 6 months before (I had told him during our first appointment). He again talked over me every time I had a question during the phone call and then ended the call abrubtly. When I went in the next day to get a copy of the report, I found he left out a few details that were not mentionned in our 5 min phone call.

Mixed experience. Competent veterinarians but disorganized staff.

One person on the phone didn't understand what a biopsy was and asked me if I wanted to pay to send it to the lab, as if that wasn't the purpose of a biopsy...

(Incidentally, on the day of the appointment, the person was quite confused that a biopsy was being done in addition to a teeth cleaning, even though I had been told twice by phone that the biopsy had been added...)

Another person on the phone didn't understand that when I said, "Could you call me back when you have the information?" I meant "you, the organization," and not her personally. She curtly told me something along the lines of, "I'm done for the day."

The technician (or was he a veterinarian doing an equivalency internship? He said he was a vet in his home country) was quite worried about my cat's weight loss (while the vet who came in later found him slightly chubby). He repeatedly asked if I was having any problems in my personal life "because cats can feel emotions."

Then there's the fact that they make appointment reminder phone calls instead of text messages, which seems rather old-fashioned to me and a waste of time for everyone.
The vet only spoke English and misinterpreted my cat's vaccination form. The receptionist corrected the mistake. So, not a very good experience for me.

Update: The test was never actually done, and now I have to chase after a refund... and everyone I talk to has a different story. It's exhausting and, above all, unprofessional. Waiting more than two weeks for nonexistent results is unacceptable.

_____________________________

Initially, I thought it was a great find: quick appointment, reasonable prices, friendly staff, and close to home. However, for the past two weeks, I've been leaving messages to get my cat's results... and the vet never calls me back despite the six reminders recorded in my file. I'm told they'll call me back without fail, but I never get a response and I'm still waiting for my cat's results. It gives the impression that the test was never done, but obviously already paid for, and that there are no results to give. I understand he may be overwhelmed, but 2 weeks to get a call regarding results seems excessive, considering the test was done a month ago.

This clinic is more expensive than others (consultation fees, vaccinations, and I won't even mention the price for nail trimming—it's outrageous).

This was my first time going to this vet, and I'm telling you it will be my last, despite its proximity... perhaps you'll have a different experience; I hope so... I now understand why getting an appointment is so easy...
Courteous and attentive staff, veterinarians who truly care about the well-being of our animals
A wonderful and dedicated team! You can feel their love for animals and their goodwill. ❤ I highly recommend them if you want to buy pet products and/or see a professional.
Don't be fooled by the exterior, the clinic is great
Thank you for the care of my cat Rocket, quick appointment for sterilization and very good follow-up.

I had an excellent experience at this veterinary clinic and couldn’t recommend them more highly. The entire team was extremely professional, kind, and attentive throughout our visit. They took wonderful care of our cat and made sure we felt comfortable and informed every step of the way.
What really stood out to us was not only the quality of care, but also their very reasonable pricing—significantly more affordable than other clinics we’ve visited, without compromising on service.
The newly renovated space is also a big plus. It’s clean, modern, and welcoming, which made the whole experience even better. We’ll definitely be returning and recommending them to others!
We have received excellent service so far during our two visits. We were given good advice and the veterinarians and technicians took great care of our little dog.
Impeccable service, they really listen to our needs and they do their job very well. I just had my kitten operated on and it went very well and was very quick.

The service was perfect, from the receptionist to the technician and the vet, who all took the time to examine my little Lola, suggest a suitable product, explain the cause of her allergic reaction to her previous shampoo, and give me advice for the future! I will definitely be back ☺️

Great clinic!
Professional and their prices are fair compared to other vets in the area. Well located overall.

Dr. Guénette suggests a very humane approach and provided me with realistic solutions for my French Bulldog's problems. All the staff were incredibly gentle with my "Frenchie," who is very shy around strangers.

Dr. Ahmed and the technician are very friendly! Dr. Ahmed gave our new dog a thorough examination and took the time to discuss common breed-related health issues. He adapts to our dog in the examination room, both for the evaluation and the vaccinations.

I took advantage of the express vaccination day; the price was great!

I'm so glad I found a Quebec veterinary clinic!

Wow! The clinic is modern and stylish, you'd expect it to be expensive, but no! On the contrary, it's much cheaper than the vets bought out by the US! And as a bonus, the staff is "A+++" friendly and helpful. They provided lots of explanations in response to my questions. Courteous and superb! I highly recommend it!

I hesitated for a long time between 1 and 2 stars, but I'm giving it 2 stars solely because of the technician, who was truly kind, attentive, and professional.

I consulted this clinic because my dog ​​had lost almost 8 kg, which is very worrying. The appointment was precisely to understand the source of the problem.
Unfortunately, the veterinarian we saw stayed with us for barely 3 minutes. She simply repeated several times that "it's not normal"—thanks, we knew that, that's exactly why we were there—without really listening or conducting a thorough investigation. We left with just a bag of special kibble, without a clear diagnosis or a serious plan, and $200 less in our pocket.

I changed clinics immediately afterward. There, my dog ​​received proper care, with examinations and genuine attention. The result: pancreatitis, which perfectly explained his weight loss.
Excellent service from the whole team

Always great service.
Becky and I are very happy with your work.
Thank you.

A very nice clinic, and conveniently located.

The reception staff were warm and professional.

Communication with the technician was less smooth.

However, I received excellent service from Dr. Hamed: friendly, thorough veterinary assessment, and clear explanations. My dog ​​loved him!
I definitely recommend this clinic. Furthermore, it's an independent clinic, proudly Quebec-based, and not affiliated with any large international companies.
My dearest

I recently adopted a 14 months old cat from the Montreal shelter and had to find a new veterinarian for booster/vaccine shots.  The Doctor and his technician were outstanding with my cat - providing the best cares my former Vet couldn't.  The technician showed me how to care and trim my cat's nails as well as how to clean her special Curly ears.  The consulting offices are very welcoming and ultra clean - they don't smell like any harsh chemicals, so your pet buddy will feel safe.  I loved using their website for booking an appointment, which was user friendly.  Wizoo Montreal is now my new trusted Veterinarian for my BFF Cat!

They do make an effort to be friendly. But their new location is extremely lacking in organization and consistency in communication, leading to an impression of incompetence and mismanagement, which caused me to cancel a spay surgery. I also found it very strange that the vet did not examine my female cat at all.Nor willing to take the time to discuss the spare surgery or answer any questions.Just walking out of the room.  When I objected to the front desk that the vet was only interested in giving her vaccines.No examination, no discussion of the upcoming spay procedure.I was told I would be given a full length form with instructions. That night I suddenly realized I could not trust their process.  I since went to another vet clinic where the veterinarian did a thorough examination talk to me about her concerns regarding an anesthetic and whether she thought she was fit for the procedure she even gave me a medication for my cat as a solution to keeping her calm for a couple of weeks until the upcoming surgery.  Finally professionalism and thoroughness I could trust.  I then realized that my instincts in cancelling everything and closing my file at Wizoo was well founded.  If you're looking for a very fluffy manner with a serious lack of concern for what surrounds a complete Hysterectomy of a cat and only have superficial matters that you need them for,  go ahead and deal with wezoo.  I personally found it to be a very upsetting as it took several days and several frustrating phone calls just to get basic travel documentation in english  till I finally managed to extricate myself from them completely.  Your mental health and the life of your pet is more important than saving a hundred bucks.  They have a lot to learn, go somewhere else.

Dr. Ahmed... I think he got his degree in a cereal box. I went to see him because my cat had an ear infection, and despite the examination and analysis of the ear, no problem was found. He even said the cat had probably scratched itself a little too hard. I found that an analysis ridiculous, especially considering the presence of discharge.

I didn't trust him, so I went to the emergency vet, and they saw an inflammatory mass called a polyp with the naked eye (see photo). How could a vet like Ahmed not have seen it? Or maybe he saw it but didn't care, or maybe he just doesn't know what he's doing.

The clinic should take better care of the professionals they hire.

Here is the photo of the polyp removed by the vet.

Excellent service.
Thank you all.

We are a couple who just adopted our first rescue cat, and we came here because our cat vomited a roundworm. We are so, SO glad we chose this clinic. The place is clean,  the customer service was incredibly kind, and above all, the veterinarian took plenty of time with our cat and explained everything we needed to know in detail.

We asked several questions about how to give the medication at home, and they  answered every single one with patience and zero frustration. We truly felt supported .

We will definitely come back to this clinic.
I will definitely be coming back, the vets are incredible and take their time with your animal. Customer service is amazing!
A wonderful experience! The staff are incredibly warm and welcoming. I highly recommend it :)

tried to get an appointment for my cats. First, the guy on the phone mispelled one of their names twice despite me spelling it on the phone multiple times, didnt properly listen to the time i would give (ex: i would say 2pm and he would then say ''for 4 pm?''). Second, the montreal clinic is only open a couple days during the week because of renovations and i got called twice to get my appointment rescheduled because ''the clinic is closed that day'' and only option is a) move the appointment another week (and then get called to move that one too) or b) go to the brossard or vaudreuil clinics which are way further and hardly accessible for me who doesnt own a car. I was very excited to find an affordable clinic, but my experience was very dissapointing and I now have to find a new clinic.
Excellent service even though it's the Émard en Reno branch in town!

The clinic was open during renovations to their new office in Montreal. The staff was courteous, the prices were reasonable—cheaper than the well-known chains, and I've called many others. The vet was very gentle and patient, and the technician was amazing—gentle and calm; he clearly loves animals.
